research.summary: A2+ PRE. Two-sided route with a strong Feyenoord carrier: independent pre-match goal expectation around 1.5 for NEC and 2.57 for Feyenoord, with both BTTS and O2.5 profiles supporting escalation rather than creating the thesis.
research.secondary_route: NEC — credible independent route; the matchup does not require a Feyenoord-only over.
research.failure_mode_resistance: HIGH-MEDIUM. Main risk is Feyenoord controlling the game while suppressing NEC rather than a lack of attacking routes.
research.recent_confirmation: Current-season goal model and BTTS/O2.5 rates confirm both routes; supporting evidence only.

choices.note: Preferred burden: two-sided route plus Feyenoord carrier supports 3-goal protection.
Protective expression if O2.75 is not acceptably priced.
Only at a stronger verified price because 3 goals merely push.

market_policy.note: HOLD if the verified market only offers a materially heavier burden.

research.summary: A2+ PRE. Clean two-sided structure: Dordrecht and Jong AZ both show repeatable scoring/conceding profiles, with independent goal expectations around 1.66 and 1.92.
research.carrier: No single dependency — Jong AZ has the slightly higher carrier ceiling, but the thesis is genuinely two-sided.
research.secondary_route: Dordrecht — strong enough to contribute independently rather than serving only as leakage.
research.failure_mode_resistance: HIGH. Primary risk is normal finishing variance rather than route absence.
research.recent_confirmation: Early-season O2.5 and BTTS rates are high for both teams; used as confirmation, not as the structural basis.

choices.note: Preferred expression for the two-sided PRE route.
Lower burden remains structurally valid.
Accept only when the verified price compensates for the push at exactly three.

market_policy.note: Do not chase a 3.25+ burden from league reputation alone.

research.summary: A2+ PRE. Hoffenheim have shown an independent goal route (4-0 cup win, then two goals in the league opener) while Dortmund supply the stronger carrier route. This is more robust than a one-team over.
research.carrier: Borussia Dortmund — strong 2–3 goal carrier ceiling.
research.secondary_route: Hoffenheim — demonstrated route survives even after the opening 3-2 defeat.
research.failure_mode_resistance: HIGH-MEDIUM. Main risk is Dortmund game control reducing transition volume.
research.recent_confirmation: Hoffenheim's 4-0 cup win and 3-2 league opener support the route; Dortmund opened the league with a controlled win.

sources.label: Sports Mole Hoffenheim v Dortmund preview

choices.note: Preferred balance of two-route support and protection at three goals.

research.summary: A2+ PRE. Young Boys provide an elite carrier and Luzern retain a credible secondary route. Independent estimates place the expected-goal environment above four combined, with both teams' current scoring environments supporting the structural thesis.
research.carrier: Young Boys — elite home carrier with a realistic 2–3+ ceiling.
research.secondary_route: Luzern — acceptable; not required to carry the match but capable of contributing.
research.failure_mode_resistance: HIGH-MEDIUM. Main risk is Luzern's away route failing and leaving Young Boys to clear a heavier total alone.
research.recent_confirmation: Young Boys' first six league matches have all cleared O2.5 in the referenced dataset; this confirms rather than creates the route.

sources.label: Forebet Young Boys v Luzern preview

choices.note: Preferred burden: three goals push while the carrier ceiling remains strong.
More protective expression if the price remains acceptable.
Only at a stronger price; full win needs four.

market_policy.note: Do not allow the high-scoring league profile to justify an excessive burden.

research.summary: A2 PRE. Brighton's route is strong and repeatable after four goals against Aston Villa and three at Chelsea; Leeds are unbeaten and have shown enough attacking mechanism to keep the secondary route alive.
research.carrier: Brighton — strong 2–3 goal carrier ceiling at home.
research.secondary_route: Leeds — acceptable, but weaker than Brighton's route and the reason this sits below the TOP group.
research.failure_mode_resistance: MEDIUM-HIGH. Main risk is Leeds' away attack failing and Brighton controlling a lower-event game.
research.recent_confirmation: Brighton have seven league goals from their opening two matches; a separate model estimates roughly 3.6 combined goal expectancy.

choices.note: Preferred expression if Leeds' secondary route survives XI.
Lower burden is structurally valid.
Heavier burden needs a materially stronger verified price.

market_policy.note: Confirmed XI is important because Brighton have multiple attacking absences/doubts.

research.summary: A2 PRE after downgrade from initial TOP. Leipzig's carrier route is very strong (opening-match xG above four with 20+ shots), but Werder's secondary route carries meaningful availability risk with several attackers/creators unavailable.
research.carrier: RB Leipzig — strong 2–3+ goal carrier ceiling.
research.secondary_route: Werder Bremen — PARTIAL pre-XI because attacking availability is weakened.
research.failure_mode_resistance: MEDIUM. Main risk is a Leipzig-only total with Werder unable to contribute.
research.recent_confirmation: Leipzig's opening performance showed dominant chance volume; Werder's team news materially lowers secondary-route confidence.

choices.note: Preferred because Werder's secondary route is not strong enough to justify an aggressive burden.
Only at a better price after confirmed XI preserves Werder's route.
High burden; requires strong compensation and intact XI routes.

market_policy.note: If Werder's attacking mechanism weakens further at XI, HOLD.

research.summary: A2-low PRE. Elversberg demonstrated a real scoring route in the 3-2 win at Leverkusen. Gladbach failed to score at Leipzig but still generated 10 box shots and hit the woodwork, so the home mechanism is PARTIAL rather than broken.
research.carrier: No elite carrier; Elversberg currently has the clearer demonstrated route.
research.secondary_route: Gladbach — acceptable/partial based on chance access rather than recent finishing.
research.failure_mode_resistance: MEDIUM. Main risk is Gladbach's finishing failure persisting, leaving Elversberg unable to carry a high line alone.
research.recent_confirmation: The opening scorelines support the matchup, but the selection is based on route access and opponent defensive weakness rather than the 3-2 result itself.

choices.note: Preferred lower burden while Gladbach's scoring route remains only partial.
Requires stronger price because three goals only give partial protection.

market_policy.note: Avoid 3.0+ unless XI materially upgrades the home route.

research.summary: A2-low PRE, carrier-heavy. Bayern have started with 5-1 in the league and 4-1 in the cup, giving them the board's clearest one-team ceiling. Schalke's independent route is weak after a 3-0 opening loss, so this cannot be treated like a two-sided over.
research.carrier: Bayern Munich — elite 3–4+ goal carrier ceiling.
research.secondary_route: Schalke — weak/partial; contribution is a bonus, not the base thesis.
research.failure_mode_resistance: MEDIUM. Main risk is a professional Bayern 2-0/3-0 win that fails a heavy total.
research.recent_confirmation: Bayern's early scoring output confirms the carrier mechanism; Schalke's scoreless opener limits the secondary route.

choices.note: Carrier-aware expression: three Bayern goals can at least protect the stake.
Safer burden if the market offers it at a usable price.
Only at strong price because a full win needs four goals.

market_policy.note: Do not let Bayern's name promote 3.5+ automatically.

research.summary: A2-low PRE, carrier-heavy. City scored six across their first two league wins and have the clear elite route; Coventry have zero league goals through two matches and several attacking/defensive absences, leaving the secondary route weak.
research.carrier: Manchester City — elite 3+ goal carrier ceiling.
research.secondary_route: Coventry — weak at PRE; the selection lives or dies on City's ability to carry.
research.failure_mode_resistance: MEDIUM. Main risk is a controlled 2-0/3-0 City win against a low-contributing opponent.
research.recent_confirmation: City improved to a 4-1 win at Crystal Palace; Coventry remain scoreless in the league. These confirm the carrier imbalance.

choices.note: Preferred carrier-aware burden with push protection at three.
More protective if available at a reasonable verified price.
Only at strong price because Coventry's route is weak.

market_policy.note: HOLD if only an aggressive 3.5+ total is available.
